title: A house you can take apart

chapters.title: A house you can take apart
narration: This is a house you can take apart.
Nineteen feet across, two hundred and seventy-seven square feet, and every piece of it fits in a pickup.

chapters.title: The frame is already on your land
narration: The frame is already standing on your land.
Two trees, split into a hundred and twenty wedges. No hubs, no jig, and three saw settings for the whole building.

chapters.title: A dome is a head, and it wears hats
narration: I stood lookout in the Arctic Circle, outside the skin of the ship.
You do not stay warm in one very good thing. You wear a lot of ordinary layers, and you put one waterproof shell over the lot.
A dome is a head. It wears hats, and only the cap is waterproof.

chapters.title: It gets warmer every winter
narration: Every quilted layer you add makes the next cap a size bigger, so there is no limit.
A rigid shell fills up and stops. This one does not.

chapters.title: The insulation is a thousand t-shirts
narration: The insulation is recycled clothing, quilted at a kitchen table.
A fully dressed dome wears nearly a thousand t-shirts, and every layer is tagged with the name of whoever sewed it.

chapters.title: Twelve thousand, and here is the invoice
narration: Twelve thousand dollars.
Ten to build, and two thousand is our profit -- twenty per cent, marked up on cost. The whole invoice is on the page.
The ground it stands on is quoted separately and we do not mark it up.

chapters.title: And it can be better later
narration: Nothing here is finished, on purpose.
A laminated hull, a steel mast, a floor bought later, and a rig that hangs the whole building between two trees. Buy them when you want them.

chapters.title: It needs three kinds of people
narration: This only works if three different people turn up.
Somebody who sews. Somebody with land who does not want to be a landlord. And somebody who wants a building.
A dome with nobody to quilt for it is a cold dome.

chapters.title: Every number is a model you can run
narration: Every figure you just saw came out of a model you can run yourself -- including the three that argue against us.
Back it, and tell us which price is wrong.
